# Plan: Fix three stale doc lines found during the auth batch

**File:** planning/2026-10-14-fix-stale-doc-lines.md
**Goal:** Make three doc lines (TASK-69) and the copies of the same stale claim state what the code does at HEAD.
**Out of scope:** Code changes, `.env`/config changes, switching `SESSION_SAME_SITE`, testing strict cookie behaviour in a browser, `docs/.vitepress/dist/` (build output, regenerated by the docs build), any other doc drift (report it, do not fix it).
**Constraints:** Docs-only; `docs/private/` is gitignored, so nothing there is committed. Per CLAUDE.md, commit straight to `main` with no branch or PR (only `docs/` and `planning/` files change). Style: no em dashes, plain `->` arrows, state facts, no hollow vocabulary.

Staleness check at HEAD (2026-10-14), all three confirmed still stale (the red-team added more):
- `docs/admin/filament-overview-explanation.md:64` says "the `Authenticate` middleware enforces this" and "`RequireActiveMember` guards the main app routes only, so the panel does not check `is_active`: an inactive admin can still reach `/admin`". Code: `Member::canAccessPanel()` (`app/Models/Member.php:79`) returns `$this->is_admin`; the panel's `authMiddleware` is `Authenticate`, `SetLocale`, `RequireActiveMember` (`AdminPanelProvider.php:58-62`), so an inactive admin is logged out and redirected (`tests/Feature/AdminPanelAccessTest.php`, 5/5 pass, verified by the red-team). Both sentences are wrong or incomplete.
- `docs/competition/ranking-service-explanation.md:5` mentions "a batch-print view". No such view or route exists (`results-howto.md:32`: "There is no print-all action").
- `planning/specs/authentication.md:45` (TASK-69 says 42; matched by text, not line) says under `strict` the token is "already spent". Since TASK-39, `GET /magic-link/{token}` only renders a confirm page (`AuthController::showMagicLinkConfirm`); `POST` consumes it (`consumeMagicLink`; `routes/web.php:41-42`). The redirect happens after the same-site POST.

Parity sites of the same two claims: `docs/env-reference.md:67` (spent token, redirect mechanism, "Must be `lax`"), `docs/docker-howto.md:122` and `docs/private/deploy-notes.md:201` ("arrive without the session cookie"), `docs/member/active-member-middleware-reference.md:29` and `:57` (inactive admin can reach the panel; "No middleware checks `is_admin`"). `docs/user-journeys.md:103` already says an inactive admin cannot reach `/admin`; use it as the wording reference.
